annotations.title: TIA — read one type/UDT as SCL source

description: Reads the SCL source of ONE user data type (UDT) and returns it INLINE with the sha256 of the code (UTF-8) and bytes. It never compiles: a type that is not consistent is refused with 409 inconsistent (compile the PLC first with tia_compile) and an unknown type with 404 not_found. `contentHash` is the stale-write guard hash of the SimaticML export (default options) of the SAME type, not of this SCL text, so what you read as SCL can be guarded like with like: pass it as `expectedContentHash` to tia_source_put (a TYPE source) or tia_types_import. The `sha256` it returns is the hash of the SCL code, and the XML reads' `normalizedSha256` is the tia_block_compare normalization (it ignores UIds). `contentHash`, `normalizedSha256` and `sha256` are different hash contracts over different normalizations: never substitute one for another, and pass only the `contentHash` of a fresh read as `expectedContentHash`. It exists only for a well-formed XML export of the type: when the serve could not compute it `contentHash` is absent and `contentHashError` says why (the code is still returned); an older serve returns neither. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/types/{type}/source. Class R. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.
name: tia_type_source
